content.location: Public Safety Devil Hunters HQ briefing room
content.environment: Flickering cold fluorescent lights, scuffed metal briefing table, thin haze of cigarette smoke

Denji.status: Wary, glaring defiantly while rubbing his neck
Denji.appearance: Lanky 6'0 teen with messy blond hair, sharp brown eyes, wearing a wrinkled white collared shirt and black tie.

Power.status: Smug, chest puffed out in chaotic triumph
Power.appearance: Long blonde hair tinted pink/red, golden cross-patterned eyes, prominent red horns, and sharp fanged teeth.

Aki Hayakawa.status: Exhausted, pinching the bridge of his nose
Aki Hayakawa.appearance: Tall 6'0 man with black hair tied into a topknot, tired blue eyes, dressed in a formal black suit.

beats.line: Gwahaha! Bow, mongrel! Even the silent monster ignores your pathetic squeaks!
beats.action: Stands atop the steel table with fists planted on her hips, grinning arrogantly down at Denji.

beats.line: Shut up, horned freak! I'm gonna beat tomorrow's training so hard everybody cries!
beats.action: Bares his sharp teeth and shakes a clenched fist back at Power.

beats.line: Shut up, both of you. You're assigned to my apartment. Move.
beats.action: Grabs the scruff of Denji's collar with one hand while stubbing out his cigarette in a metal tray.

camera.environment: smoky fluorescent glare catching the scuffed metal table beneath Power's boots

content.location: Public Safety Devil Hunters HQ hallway
content.environment: Harsh green-tinted fluorescent corridor with concrete walls and distant footsteps

Denji.appearance: Lanky 6'0 teen with messy blond hair, sharp brown eyes, wearing a wrinkled white collared shirt and black tie.

Power.appearance: Long blonde hair tinted pink/red, golden cross-patterned eyes, prominent red horns, and sharp fanged teeth.

Aki Hayakawa.appearance: Tall 6'0 man with black hair tied into a topknot, tired blue eyes, dressed in a formal black suit.

beats.line: I ride in front! The greatest driver in Japan demands shotgun!
beats.action: Shoves past Denji roughly, barging toward the exit.

beats.line: Hey! Aki, tell me about that freak in the corner! Are they really that strong?!
beats.action: Tugs Aki's sleeve frantically, glancing back nervously toward the briefing doors.

beats.line: Hands off. And if you value your neck, you won't bring them up again.
beats.action: Swats Denji's hand away and keeps walking with a dark scowl.

camera.environment: flickering green fluorescent corridor casting hard shadows against scuffed concrete

content.environment: Cramped apartment corridor with fluorescent tube flickering over peeling wallpaper

Denji.status: intrigued and defensive, holding dirty shoes
Denji.appearance: Lanky 6'0 teen with messy blond hair, sharp brown eyes, wearing a wrinkled white collared shirt and black tie.

Power.status: proudly shoving past into the doorway

Aki Hayakawa.status: deeply exhausted, keys jingling in hand

beats.line: Behold, my new kingdom! Where is the blood throne?!
beats.action: Kicks the front door wide open and stomps across the tatami with muddy shoes.
Pinches the bridge of his nose, his voice dropping into a deadly whisper.

beats.line: Man, if that creepy guy is training us tomorrow, I need a ton of toast first.
beats.action: Peers past Aki into the kitchen, rubbing his stomach eagerly.

camera.environment: dim hallway lit by sickly buzzing fluorescent tube with fresh muddy footprints staining clean tatami mats
